text_block_list.text:
Today is the day of the Fan Appreciation Festival.
To express gratitude to the fans who cheer for them daily, the Umamusume entertain them with fun competitive games.

text_block_list.name: Epi's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~~!! Epi-chan, found you!
We came to cheer for you-!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!!
I'll definitely make sure you have a great time!

text_block_list.name: Epi's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Epi-san...
—Ugh, I need more courage...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
YOU!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Those clothes have the same colors as my racing silks!
Could you actually be a fan of mine!?

text_block_list.name: Epi's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah... T-That's right...!
Um, I was watching... the Kikuka Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see, you came to cheer me on!
Well then, I'll make sure to put a huge smile on your face!

text_block_list.name: Epi's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Th-Thank you so much!
I'll cheer for you with all my might...!

With so many fans rushing to the venue,
Epiphaneia's motivation was burning even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
That girl...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
HEEEEY!!!!
Long time no see, you!!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah... Epi-san...
choice_data_list: …Are you okay? You're looking a little pale…

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...I-I'm fine.
It's just that the training was... a bit rough...
*Cough*...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Are you all right?!
Let's get you some rest right away!"

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm really fine, honestly...!
I've never had a very strong constitution... But—

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Because you said... it'll "absolutely"
be all right—I'll do my best...!

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Um, Epi-san... you're competing, right?
I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you!
If you're feeling up to it, come watch me!
choice_data_list: ...We gotta give this event our best shot!
...We gotta give this event our best shot!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! I'll fire up
your heart too!
And the challenge Epiphaneia takes on is—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Inter-team competition!
"Scavenger Word-Chain Relay"!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
In this event, teams decided by the ghost leg lottery
will face off in a relay!
However, this is no ordinary relay!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The baton to pass to the next runner
must be a borrowed item that continues the word chain (shiritori)!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: For example, let's say the previous runner hands you "chikyuu" (Earth)! The next runner would then find "usagi" (rabbit) to continue the shiritori chain!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
An event that demands not only running ability, but quick wits as well!
Now then, let's introduce the White Team first!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Fate really does love me after all!
—Getting to be with everyone I love so much!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, quite a surprise, isn't it?
I look forward to working with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A scavenger hunt plus Shiritori... It tests your intuition and your vocabulary, huh.
Interesting!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Leave all the running around to me! Moving my body is what I do best!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Challenging the star-studded White Team
is our ultra-powerful Red Team...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I leave it in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"This is the best team ever!
Victory is guaranteed, yes♪"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Shall we declare it?
—"We are the ones who will win"!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Go for it, White Team!
I can't wait to see everyone's showstopper frames!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Go, Red Team, fight! Only 100 miles left till victory!

Amidst the growing excitement and roaring cheers—
the competition began!
Team Epiphaneia will run the relay in this order: Cesario, Vodka, Rulership, and Epiphaneia. The first prompt is—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh!?
Th-This is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "What's wrong, Cesario! Hit a tough question already!?"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's about this...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I see!
...Yes, that's it, voice!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Cesario, go to the roof!
I'm sure the answer is up there!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san!
Here—a 'conch shell'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Got it! It starts with "i", right?!
...Wait, "i"?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
S... Sq!?
...Squid!? At the harbor!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's wrong, Vodka!!!!
It's a field!! Run!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ruler-senpai!!
It's "Strawberry"!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ichigo... ending with 'go'!
I can think of a few words, but—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
All of them seem difficult to find.
In this RTA situation, I need to narrow it down from nearby areas!
Which means, the answer is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: RUUULEEEERRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
No, stop!! Don't say it, don't say it!
—'Cause it's probably the same thing!

Thanks to the tremendous efforts of Epiphaneia and the voice of destiny,
the White Team's baton (?) was passed smoothly along, and—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! Take this!
—It's "sesame senbei"!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!! It connected!
In that case, the finale is—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You're right, this is it!!
"Dog"!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Alright, to the finish line—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Kris S!! I see,
you're the anchor too...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
In that case!!
—It's a duel!!

text_block_list.name: Epi & Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Haaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!
—Ngh...!!!!
choice_data_list: (The two of them came charging in...!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: What heat!! An insanely fierce battle is unfolding right before our eyes!! Who will emerge as the winning team...?!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S, it's Symboli Kris S!
With an astounding late burst, she snatches the win!
Victory goes to the Red Team!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaaargh!!
I lost!!!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was holding onto that plushie so tightly
that it might have messed up my form...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Was that stuffed animal that precious to you?
Could it be Epi-san's...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No! This was borrowed!
So part of it was taking good care of it, but—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Come on, isn't it obvious just looking at it?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This little guy looks just like Kris S!
So I just couldn't bring myself to treat him roughly!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If we lost to the real deal after all that,
there's no helping it!
Though she suffered defeat, the Fan Appreciation Festival concluded to immense excitement.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text: Crossing the finish line first is Epiphaneia!! Victory goes to the White Team!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...!! She beat Kris S!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations.
You have become—strong.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Kris S...! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, challenge me on equal terms!
...You were holding back so the mortar wouldn't fall, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'm pulling ahead of you by ten lengths!
Look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Oooooh...!" "So hype!!"
"That was amazing to watch!" "Great job out there!"
"Epi-san, you were so cool...!"

And so, the Fan Appreciation Festival
wrapped up to roaring excitement!
